name: Vaettir
resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
notes: CR 1. Nature spirit. Neutral unless its feature is threatened.
gm_notes: Session 3 forest. Protective of specific features (old trees, springs, ancient stones). Hostile only if those features are threatened or damaged. Players who show respect (DC 10 Nature or DC 12 Persuasion) can pass without incident. Knows the forest and can guide -- if approached correctly.
